bibl.title: Divination, Pyromancy, Hesiod: P. Gen. inv. 161 has More to Offer.
bibl.seg: William Furley & Victor Gysembergh, Divination, Pyromancy, Hesiod: P. Gen. inv. 161 has More to Offer.
bibl.note: Reedition of P. Gen. Inv. 161 (= MP3 2106.1; LDAB 8895). - Argue that the fragments come from a bookroll on the general subject of sacrifice and divination, which seems to have consisted of excerpts from technical treatises.
